title: 2007 AMC 10B Problem 7
statement: All sides of the convex pentagon \(ABCDE\) are of equal length, and \(\angle A = \angle B = 90^\circ.\) What is the degree measure of \(\angle E?\)

solutions.text:
Because \(AB=BC=EA\) and \(\angle A=\angle B=90^\circ,\) quadrilateral \(ABCE\) is a square, so \(\angle AEC=90^\circ.\)

The remaining sides satisfy \(CD=DE=EC,\) so \(\triangle CDE\) is equilateral and \(\angle CED=60^\circ.\)

Therefore \(\angle E=\angle AEC\) \(+\angle CED=90^\circ\) \(+60^\circ=150^\circ.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: Two right angles at adjacent vertices make part of the figure a square
\(ABCE\) is a square and \(\triangle CDE\) is equilateral
